# Series 2

## Exercise 2.1

### A




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# create timeseries object
t <- seq(1, 100, length = 100)
data <- 0.5 * t + 1 + runif(100, -1, 1)

ts <- ts(data)
plot(ts)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-1-1.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
length(ts)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 100
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Applying backward differencing
ts.2 <- diff(ts, lag = 1)
plot(ts.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-1-2.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
length(ts.2)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 99
```


:::
:::




The new time series are 99 units long instead of 100.

### B




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# create timeseries object
t <- seq(1, 100, length = 100)
data <- 2 * t **2 + 3 * t - 1 + runif(100, -200, 200)

ts <- ts(data)
plot(ts)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-2-1.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
length(ts)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 100
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Applying backward differencing
ts.2 <- diff(ts, lag = 1)
plot(ts.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-2-2.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
length(ts.2)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 99
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Again Applying backward differencing
ts.3 <- diff(ts.2, lag = 1)
plot(ts.3)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-2-3.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
length(ts.3)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 98
```


:::
:::




Since we applied backward differencing twice, the length of the output time series increased to 98.

## Exercise 2.2

### A




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hstart <- read.table("../../sp26/rtp/data/hstart.dat")

ts <- ts(hstart[, 1], start = c(1966, 1), frequency = 12)
hstart_stl <- stl(ts, s.window = "periodic")

plot(hstart_stl)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-3-1.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
:::
:::




### B




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hstart <- read.table("../../sp26/rtp/data/hstart.dat")

ts <- ts(hstart[, 1], start = c(1966, 1), frequency = 12)

weights <- c(1, rep(2, 11), 1) / 24
filtered <- filter(ts, filter = weights)

plot(ts)
points(filtered, type = "l", col = "blue")
lines(hstart_stl$time.series[, "trend"], col = "red")
```

## Exercise 2.3




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
data(co2)
plot(diff(co2, 1), type = "n", ylim = c(-5, 15))

for (l in 1:12) {
    ts_diff <- diff(co2, lag = l)
    lines(ts_diff, col = rainbow(12)[l])
}
legend("topleft", legend = paste("Lag", 1:12), col = rainbow(12), lty = 1, ncol = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](rtp02_exercise_02_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-6-1.pdf){fig-pos='H'}
